title: PRE-REGISTRATION — verifier co-adaptation to the generator's sampling temperature
written: 2026-08-14, BEFORE the cold temperature ladder (decoding_ladder_cold_2026-08-14) reported. Written blind to which temperature wins, so the design cannot be tuned to the outcome.
status: NOT YET RUN — queued behind the cold ladder, which must name the peak first
the_question: Every verifier this project has trained (~27 architectures) used candidate pools generated at temperature 0.7. The 2026-08-13 sweep then evaluated those frozen verifiers on pools generated at other temperatures. That is an uncontrolled train/inference distribution mismatch. How large is it, and how much accuracy is left on the table by not co-adapting the verifier to the generator?
why_this_is_not_a_rediscovery: All ~27 exhausted verifier approaches varied the ARCHITECTURE or the OBJECTIVE while holding the training DATA fixed. None changed the training distribution to match the inference distribution. This is a distribution-match question, not an architecture question, and it is untested.

established_facts_this_rests_on.verifier_recipe: lora_r 16, alpha 32, dropout 0.05, target q/k/v/o_proj + gate/up/down_proj, base lingshu-medical-mllm/Lingshu-7B, max_pixels 1003520, lr 1e-4, bs 2 x accum 8, 1 epoch, 5182 steps, seed 0, 107.7 train-minutes, pos_rate 0.199, n_train_examples 10364 (ckpts/train/lora_verifier_disjoint/train_config.json)
established_facts_this_rests_on.frozen_verifier_at_T05: SELECTED +0.00569 [+0.00100,+0.01038] judge / +0.00796 [+0.00341,+0.01265] EM vs an in-session T=0.7 control (decoding_sweep_2026-08-13.json)
established_facts_this_rests_on.direction_of_the_existing_bias: The frozen verifier is best matched to T=0.7, which is the CONTROL, and out-of-distribution at colder T. The measured T=0.5 win is therefore CONSERVATIVE.

design.target_temperature: T* = whichever temperature the cold ladder crowns as the peak. NOT assumed to be 0.5. If the ladder's peak is not CI-clean in both currencies, use T=0.5 (the established both-currency winner) and say so.
arms: A. frozen verifier (trained at T=0.7) scoring T=0.7 pools  -- the deployed baseline, in-session
B. frozen verifier (trained at T=0.7) scoring T* pools     -- the current result; measures the TRANSFER PENALTY against A
C. co-adapted verifier (retrained on T* pools) scoring T* pools -- measures the CO-ADAPTATION GAIN against B

D. co-adapted verifier (retrained on T* pools) scoring T=0.7 pools -- the reverse-transfer control; if C beats B only because retraining helps everywhere, D will beat A by a similar margin and the effect is NOT about distribution match
design.arm_D_is_the_load_bearing_control: Without D, a gain in C is uninterpretable -- it could be a better verifier rather than a better-matched one. D separates them.
design.training_discipline: Identical recipe to the incumbent in every respect except the temperature of the candidate pools: same seed, same steps, same composition quotas, same pos_rate target, same max_pixels, same disjoint split asserted on md5 of DECODED RGB pixels (train images only). Composition matching is mandatory -- the incumbent's taken_examples_per_source must be reproduced so provenance is the only variable.
design.seeds: >=10 for anything trained; report mean, sd, range and the seed-averaged deployable number. A prior 'win' in this project was the top of its own 10-seed range.
design.currencies: BOTH the 32B judge and normalised exact match, on identical verifier picks. The judge's prompt instructs leniency about phrasing and synonyms, and repetition_penalty 1.10 has already been caught winning under the judge purely by harvesting that leniency.

endpoints.primary: SELECTED accuracy, C vs B, paired item bootstrap nboot=10000, n=2345
endpoints.transfer_penalty: B vs A -- how much the frozen verifier loses by being off-distribution
endpoints.specificity_check: D vs A -- must be materially SMALLER than C vs B for the effect to be about distribution match
endpoints.secondary: sel_eff, oracle@8 (unchanged by construction within a temperature), contested stratum (n~845), laterality stratum, per-cell guardrail

predictions_registered_in_advance.transfer_penalty_B_vs_A: expected to be SMALL -- the T=0.5 win was obtained despite it
predictions_registered_in_advance.coadaptation_gain_C_vs_B: predicted +0.000 to +0.010 SELECTED; the project's prior is that verifier changes move less than the ~0.021 seed spread, but this changes the DATA rather than the architecture, which is untested
predictions_registered_in_advance.most_likely_outcome: C vs B not significant, in which case the finding is that the frozen verifier transfers across temperature -- which STRENGTHENS the free-knob claim rather than weakening it

success_and_kill.success: C vs B CI-clean positive in BOTH currencies, guardrail-clean, AND D vs A materially smaller than C vs B
success_and_kill.kill_1: C vs B CI covers zero in either currency -> report that the frozen verifier transfers, and close the co-adaptation lever
success_and_kill.kill_2: D vs A is comparable to C vs B -> the gain is generic retraining, not distribution match; report as such and do not claim co-adaptation
success_and_kill.kill_3: the co-adapted verifier's own null test fails to reproduce the frozen metric -> stop and report

interpretation_committed_in_advance.if_gain_is_small: The generator and verifier are separable; a sampling knob can be turned without retraining. This makes the T* result a genuinely free deployment change.
interpretation_committed_in_advance.if_gain_is_large: Generator and verifier must be tuned JOINTLY, and every past verifier experiment in this project was handicapped by a train/inference mismatch nobody controlled for. That would be a significant methodological finding about the ~27 prior negatives and must be reported as such, including the possibility that some of them would look different under co-adaptation.

cost: One LoRA retrain per arm at ~108 GPU-minutes (train_config train_minutes 107.7), plus verifier re-scoring of the eval pools under HF transformers (NEVER vLLM -- it silently drops all 192 visual.* modules, 0.775204 HF vs 0.702997 vLLM).
standing_caveats_that_apply: +-0.008 open-text reproducibility: every arm needs an in-session matched control; the stored-vs-in-session nuisance shift was measured at 1.184x the effect being tested
numerics must be pinned and stated (TF32, CPU thread count, feature row order, ranker choice)
